metrics.preferred_job_title: Project & Sales Manager | Experienced Team Lead
metrics.profile_summary: Results-oriented professional with a background in project management, sales strategy, and team leadership. Experienced in managing digital projects and leading high-performing teams to optimize operations and revenue growth.

experience.description: Executes end-to-end project management for media and sales campaigns, driving revenue growth through strategic outreach and client relationship optimization.
Supervised and mentored a chat support team, monitoring performance metrics and resolving complex client escalations to maintain SLA standards.

weaknesses: Lacks required 5-7 years of total marketing experience
No mention of GA4 or advanced ad platform reporting
No evidence of budget management or brand strategy ownership
evaluation.summary: The candidate possesses leadership and sales skills but lacks the seniority and specific technical marketing expertise (GA4, ROI/CAC reporting, brand strategy) required for this role.
